limits: No new source target or response eligibility is chosen here; apply the separate frozen protocol to this inventory.
Exact reference checks establish interval/strand consistency, not genome-wide uniqueness or biological causality.
DNA-only author/MaveDB correspondence does not assert numerical outcome equality.
Seven all-NA identity rows in the original MSMB file were not in the old explored MaveDB table and are explicitly recorded rather than assigned DNA.
GRCh38_GP1BA.tsv is the author filename for the exact chr22 GP1BB source target here; the mapping is established from full DNA and every allele, not the filename.
scope: All 55,276 old Agarwal cores, all 15 explored Kircher assays at ten unique promoter loci (nine primary non-HBB plus HBB), every source-resolved old SNV/deletion identity irrespective of QC, and explored HBB genomic/ClinVar reference intervals. This is a DNA/locus exposure inventory, not a new biological cohort.
snv_homology_factorization: For a query200nt sequence, match each reference window on both strands. <=20 mismatches qualifies directly. At21 mismatches, an exposed single substitution can qualify iff its documented position/alternate matches the query at one mismatch. >21 mismatches cannot be rescued by one substitution. This exactly represents >=90% homology to every exposed single-SNV200nt window without materializing about one million copies. All distinct deletion-created windows are explicit.
window_semantics: Full native constructs are retained at original lengths. The 200nt windows are derived exclusion-only DNA substrings, not claimed native reporter constructs. HBB187nt and its186nt deletion constructs have no200nt windows; their locus is still excluded by the genomic guard.
